title: Optical transitions between programmes
slide_intent: Make transitions recognizable without requiring every programme image to share a style.
strategic_value: Recurring gradient rooms and the green 4 can join Channel 4’s varied entertainment footage.
demonstration: The sequence alternates gradient-room logo moments with clips from multiple programmes, using horizontal and vertical panel movement.
practical_value: Compare how a repeated transition joins footage with different lighting, subject and pace.
